title: My Morning
text:
My name is Lin. I live in a small flat with my sister. Our flat has two rooms and a kitchen.

I get up at seven every morning. I drink some water and open the window. The air is cool.

My sister makes tea. I put bread and two eggs on the table. We eat breakfast together.

At eight, we leave home. She takes the bus. I walk to work. It is a good start to the day.
textTranslate:
我叫林。我和姐姐住在一套小公寓里。我们的公寓有两个房间和一个厨房。

我每天早上七点起床。我喝一些水，然后打开窗户。空气很凉爽。

姐姐泡茶。我把面包和两个鸡蛋放在桌上。我们一起吃早饭。

八点钟，我们离开家。她坐公共汽车。我步行去上班。这是一天的美好开始。

title: At the Small Shop
text:
There is a small shop near my school. A friendly man works there. His name is Mr Lee.

Today I need a notebook and a pen. The notebooks are on a shelf. I choose a blue one.

"How much is this notebook?" I ask. "Three pounds," he says. The pen is one pound.

I give him four pounds. He puts my things in a paper bag. I say thank you and walk to school.
textTranslate:
我的学校附近有一家小商店。一位友好的男士在那里工作。他叫李先生。

今天我需要一本笔记本和一支笔。笔记本放在架子上。我选了一本蓝色的。

“这本笔记本多少钱？”我问。“三英镑。”他说。那支笔一英镑。

我给了他四英镑。他把我的东西装进一个纸袋。我道了谢，步行去学校。

title: Our New Neighbour
text:
A new family lives next door. There are three people in the family: a mother, a father and a little boy.

The boy is six years old. He has a red bike. Every afternoon, he rides it in front of the house.

My brother has a bike too. The two boys play together. Their parents watch them from the garden.

On Sunday, we have lunch with our new neighbours. There is rice, fish and fruit. Everyone is happy.
textTranslate:
隔壁住进了一个新家庭。这家有三口人：妈妈、爸爸和一个小男孩。

男孩六岁。他有一辆红色自行车。每天下午，他都在房子前面骑车。

我弟弟也有一辆自行车。两个男孩一起玩。他们的父母在花园里看着他们。

星期天，我们和新邻居一起吃午饭。有米饭、鱼和水果。每个人都很开心。

title: A Day in the Park
text:
It is Saturday. The sky is blue and the sun is warm. My friend Anna and I go to the park.

We sit under a big tree. Anna reads a book. I look at the birds. A small dog runs past us.

At twelve, we eat our lunch. I have a cheese sandwich. Anna has an apple and some bread.

After lunch, we walk by the lake. We take some photos and then go home. We like this quiet place.
textTranslate:
今天是星期六。天空湛蓝，阳光温暖。我和朋友安娜去公园。

我们坐在一棵大树下。安娜看书。我看小鸟。一只小狗从我们身边跑过。

十二点，我们吃午饭。我带了一个奶酪三明治。安娜带了一个苹果和一些面包。

午饭后，我们沿着湖边散步。我们拍了一些照片，然后回家。我们喜欢这个安静的地方。
